issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the solution implementation returns an int and the intended behavior (sum of inscribed + guest students) is numeric. This mismatch can mislead students when choosing the return type and implementing related methods (e.g., getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) since the textual description also refers to checking the UML for the expected return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Prefer changing the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and update any textual references) so it matches the numeric nature of the method and the solution implementation. Alternatively, if a String is truly intended, update the solution and template implementations to return a String (e.g., String.valueOf(total)) and adjust related methods accordingly.
